name: client
_comment_overview: Client workspace manifest for the BHVR Edge RPG React + PixiJS v8 + Tailwind CSS v4 frontend. Uses Vite 6 for bundling and dev proxying (/api and /ws) to the Cloudflare Worker backend.

_comment_scripts.dev: Starts the Vite development server with HMR and backend proxy rules.
_comment_scripts.typecheck: Typechecks the client against the server's emitted AppType declarations.
_comment_scripts.build: Runs strict TypeScript typechecking (tsc --noEmit) before creating the production bundle in dist/.

_comment_dependencies.hono: Provides typed RPC client utilities (hono/client) matching the server's AppType export.
_comment_dependencies.pixi.js: Renders the 2D overworld map, buildings, walls, and interpolated player sprites on HTML5 Canvas.
_comment_dependencies.react: Core UI library for authentication, matchmaking status, HUD controls, and BattleModal.
_comment_dependencies.react-dom: DOM renderer for mounting React components into #root.
